item.title: I think self-checkout lanes at Walmart are great and we shouldn’t worry about the skip-scammers
item.description: "I think that the self checkout in Walmarts are a great idea. It keeps stress off workers and easier for customers not having to wait in line. If people are worried about people stealing, then get better security. Hiring seniors for security is not the answer. And for those complaining about people stealing, just do your shopping and don’t worry about others." - An Ocala resident shares his opinion.
